## Chardham Yatra Packages 2026 (per person)

- Ek Dham (1 shrine): 3N/4D Rs 11,399 or 4N/5D Rs 13,800
- Do Dham (Kedarnath + Badrinath): 4N/5D Rs 13,800 or 6N/7D Rs 18,600
- Char Dham (Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath): 8N/9D Rs 24,000 or 10N/11D Rs 27,600
- Details: https://cpgstoursandtravels.in/chardham-yatra-package

Packages include hotel stay, daily breakfast, sightseeing cab/transfers and trip support. Flights/trains to the start point, meals beyond breakfast and activity tickets are extra. Every package is customizable; final quote is confirmed on WhatsApp before payment.
